## qrcode-generator 2.0.4

Produces the QR matrices drawn by `gif.js` and by the app. Source: npm `qrcode-generator@2.0.4`,
file `dist/qrcode.mjs`. Licence: MIT, see [qrcode.LICENSE](qrcode.LICENSE).

| File | SHA-256 |

| `qrcode.mjs` | `ea91d7118a5395289170da848b7c6758b996163bfbccf312591ab65a4911b7c0` |

To update, run `npm pack qrcode-generator@<version>`, replace the file, update the version and
digest above, and run `npm test`.
